# Architectural Build Plan Update

Date: July 30, 2026
Folder: /plan-documents

1. Platform Status Overview

The UDI-enabled platform is now entering the stabilization and integration phase. Core subsystems—including config-merge, folder-tree, scraper, primitives, ASTalyzer, Universe, and VaultGuard—are positioned for full ecosystem activation.

1. Current Architectural Milestones

Core Infrastructure

Deterministic config-merge engine

Canonical folder-tree traversal module

Scraper module for metadata and schema extraction

Primitives layer for UDI-normalized objects

Analysis & Canonicalization

ASTalyzer pipeline for AST generation and validation

Universe editor for schema management and canonical editing

Security Substrate

VaultGuard onboarding plan established

Policy, secrets, and RBAC integration points defined

1. Next Architectural Milestones

3.1 VaultGuard Full Onboarding

VaultGuard must be fully integrated before legacy project onboarding. This includes:

Canonical schema creation

Secrets-provider and policy-enforcer integration

RBAC authority registration

Universe menu and tooling integration

3.2 Legacy Project Integration Sequence

Once VaultGuard is online, legacy systems will be onboarded in the following deterministic order:

tUilKit

ThoughtFire

Prism Suite

Chromaverse Suite

V4l1d8r

M3m01r5

Syncbot

Additional projects

Each project will undergo:

Scraper ingestion

Primitive normalization

UDI assignment

ASTalyzer validation

Universe canonicalization

1. Post-Integration Platform Evolution

After full UDI integration, the platform transitions into an ecosystem phase:

Cross-project introspection and dependency mapping

Automated schema evolution and refactoring

Composition of multi-app workflows

Secure automation via VaultGuard

Expansion of Universe into new schema domains

Self-maintaining ecosystem capabilities

1. Immediate Action Items

Finalize VaultGuard schema definitions

Implement VaultGuard service runtime

Connect VaultGuard to Universe and primitives

Prepare tUilKit ingestion pipeline

Validate ASTalyzer readiness for multi-project ingestion

1. Upcoming Planning Documents

VaultGuard UDI Onboarding Blueprint

Legacy Project Integration Playbook

Universe Expansion Roadmap

Ecosystem Automation Strategy

1. Summary

The platform is ready to transition from foundational construction to ecosystem integration. VaultGuard onboarding is the critical next step, unlocking secure and deterministic onboarding for all legacy projects and enabling the broader evolution of the UDI-driven architecture.
